## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation
- [ ] I ran the documented tests.
- [ ] I ran configured lint/type checks.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behavior changed.
- [ ] Documentation/examples were updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets or private/confidential data were added.

## Security
- [ ] This change does not introduce a known security regression.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior includes regression coverage.

## Reviewer notes
Explain important design decisions, limitations, or follow-up work.
